issues.where: frames 980–1007, central crater pair and horizon
issues.what: The climb largely unwinds the dive: the same crater pair shrinks along almost the same track as the horizon rolls back. This makes the exit read like a camera reversal rather than a continuing flyby.
issues.fix: Carry some of the terrain pass's downrange movement into the climb and ease onto a slightly offset outbound arc so foreground craters and the horizon separate along a new path.

issues.what: The globe's crater pattern changes very little relative to the limb. The drift reads mostly as camera movement rather than independent planetary rotation.
issues.fix: Keep the rotation slow, but give a recognizable sunlit marking a little more movement relative to the limb without speeding up the camera.
